sections.Profile:
The "Score-Board" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in April 1956, is a four-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1956
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Women, Wood Rail, Original Theme
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Wayne Neyens
- Art: Roy Parker
